result.title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
result.summary: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventional MFBO by 61%. Knowledge quality, rather than the choice of LLM, determined whether the search was accelerated, as shown by a controlled study that varied the two independently. A knowledge-level ablation further quantified the contribution of each knowledge statement. These results show that LLM-interpreted expert knowledge can complement numerical data as an information source in MFBO.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LLM 辅助的多保真贝叶斯优化：由专家描述低保真模型缺失的物理，LLM 判断两个设计中哪个需要更大的带符号残差修正，成对高斯过程将这些判断转为知识基，再由高保真数据校准其贡献与符号，在锂电池设计上把遗憾面积降低 61%。
AI.relevance_reason: 「LLM 定性判断转为结构化先验、再用真实反馈校准其权重与符号」这一机制，可能为 LVR 中注入 LLM 先验又不盲信、以及 latent 内容的贡献分配与校准提供可核查的方法线索；应用域与视觉推理无关。
